title: Snappy dashboard, direct lane links, faster checks
goal: The dashboard stays fast with many plans and lanes; Office's Open in Lanes lands on the agent's detail; the check suite gives a fast default run so features ship sooner. Release 0.5.4.
now: Closed: 0.5.4 released: polls about 25 ms (was 1 s at 100 lanes), lane loading state, fast and full check sets (1.5 min and 4 min)

waves.name: Wave 1 · Poll cost
waves.note: Contract: checks/perf.check.mjs (100 lanes, 8 plans, median under 60 ms; baseline about 1000 ms).

lanes.why: mtime-keyed JSON cache and one lanes()/plans() snapshot per request instead of re-reading every file per plan and per lane

next: Lead: Office agent window Open in Lanes goes to #/lane/<id>
Lead: time every check, split into a fast default (npm run check) and the full release suite (npm run check:full)
Merge perf, run the fast suite, then the full suite once before the release
Release 0.5.4: push, install from a packed copy, sync the skill, restart the dashboard

decisions.text: Lag cause measured, not guessed: browser main thread about 3% busy; the server spends 200 to 330 ms per poll (1 s at 100 lanes), 70% in readFileSync+JSON.parse because planView calls lanes() per plan and every lane status calls plans(). Two open tabs keep the single-threaded dashboard about half busy.
Plan closed: 0.5.4 released: polls about 25 ms (was 1 s at 100 lanes), lane loading state, fast and full check sets (1.5 min and 4 min).

risks: A cache that hands out shared objects could leak one request's mutation into the next.
Dropping slow browser checks from the default run could let a UI regression through: the full suite still runs before every release.
